SELECT m.menu_id AS "menuId",COALESCE(a.inq_yn,'N')='Y' AS "inquire",COALESCE(a.reg_yn,'N')='Y' AS "register", COALESCE(a.upd_yn,'N')='Y' AS "update",COALESCE(a.del_yn,'N')='Y' AS "delete",COALESCE(a.upld_yn,'N')='Y' AS "upload", COALESCE(a.dnld_yn,'N')='Y' AS "download",COALESCE(a.cnfm_yn,'N')='Y' AS "confirm", m.upper_menu_id AS "parentId",m.menu_nm AS "name",m.scrn_id AS "screenId",m.use_yn='Y' AS "use" FROM tb_sy_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_sy_role_menu_auth a ON a.menu_id=m.menu_id AND a.role_id=#{roleId} WHERE m.menu_lvl=2 ORDER BY m.upper_menu_id,m.sort_ord,m.menu_id
